Privacy and analytics

How LAFMAT uses optional audience measurement on this website.

Who operates this website

This website is maintained by the LAFMAT network. For questions or requests, use the Contact page.

What is measured after acceptance

Google Analytics 4 measures visits and useful link clicks, using a pseudonymous browser cookie and technical information such as device/browser and approximate region. LAFMAT sends only known page addresses without query parameters or fragments, language and bounded action categories. Contact fields, free-text searches, email addresses, telephone numbers and message text are not sent as analytics parameters.

Your choice

Before acceptance, this site does not load the Google analytics tag or send analytics events. Rejecting keeps it off. You can reopen Analytics preferences from the footer and withdraw consent. Withdrawal stops subsequent collection, clears the analytics cookies available to this site and reloads the page; it does not automatically delete data previously collected with consent.

Storage and retention

The consent choice is stored locally for up to 180 days. Analytics cookies are configured for up to 180 days. Event/user data retention is configured for 2 months; aggregated Google reports may follow a different retention policy. Google processes consented analytics data under its own terms and privacy policy.

No advertising

Google Signals, advertising personalization, remarketing and User-ID are not enabled for this integration.

Other services

YouTube, Facebook and Google Scholar follow their own privacy policies. Embedded players in the conference archive may connect to YouTube when the page opens. The analytics preference controls this Google Analytics integration, not those external services. A click to a recording is not proof of playback; an email link or draft is not proof that an email was sent.

Questions and requests

Contact LAFMAT through the Contact page for questions about this website or requests concerning analytics data.
